## Overview

This [[adyen]] page is an **iOS integration chooser** for Napas card. It links iOS Drop-in and Components method guides and two general iOS Sessions-flow guides. See [[adyen-online-payments]] and [[adyen-ios-sdk]]. The page is marked last modified in 2020 and captured 2026-09-15; it is navigation, not current merchant-eligibility or payment-outcome evidence.

## Key takeaways

- **Drop-in** is presented as an all-in-one UI route; **Components** links to a page described here as a **Redirect Component**. These child-guide labels do not specify card-number/PIN/OTP custody, exact method identifiers, return/details processing or final result. See raw lines 19–27.
- Its final line points to general iOS Drop-in and Components **Sessions-flow** guides. This is a navigation selection, not a statement that Advanced flows are unavailable or a substitute for child-guide prerequisites. See raw line 29.
- No Vietnam currency/merchant eligibility, test-card/OTP scenario, Customer Area setup, SDK version, provider-gateway behavior or settlement/refund procedure appears on this chooser. Those require the pinned Napas overview and relevant child guide; a link itself does not evidence card handling or authorization. See full raw lines 15–29.

- **iOS Drop-in and Redirect Component child routes:** raw lines 19–27.
- **General Sessions-flow links:** raw line 29.
